issue_request: FHIR-37923 is a Published/Persuasive Vocab R5 change request asking to remove the VSD Aligned Value Set Profile at vsd-alignedvalueset because the shareable, computable, publishable, and executable ValueSet profiles made it unnecessary.
initial_application: Git commit 7e9abff20ff2a77c8866dcbb748cc37d917c656d applied the request by removing StructureDefinition/vsd-alignedvalueset from source/valueset/implementationguide-ValueSet-core.xml and deleting source/valueset/structuredefinition-profile-vsd-alignedvalueset.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-31395 created the replacement ValueSet profile family in core, FHIR-36015/FHIR-32366 record related guidance-text work, and later FHIR-38833/FHIR-37959 moved or prepared the shareable/publishable/computable/executable family for CRMI/THO ownership. Those later changes do not require restoring or editing the removed VSD-aligned profile. Confluence minutes align with the Jira removal path, and Zulip/Extension Pack searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current core source has no vsd-alignedvalueset file, no ValueSet core IG registration for it, and no matching source text for the removed profile identifiers.
